article.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a high-severity security flaw impacting UnrealIRCd, an open-source Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. article.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident

article.title: Apple Reveals How Secure Exclaves Shield Camera and Microphone Data
